context.transcript:
In local news, we have a report from the Pinebrook Community Centre where activities are underway to plan a vegetable garden.
The project was started by Jessica Plank, the director of the centre.
Ms Plank has been recognised for her work at the centre before.
Just last month, she was honoured for her commitment to community... service at the Town's Outstanding Citizens' Awards ceremony.
All of the gardening tools for the project were donated by the Endo Company, one of the area's largest landscaping firms.
context.transcript_translation:
在当地新闻中，我们有来自 Pinebrook Community Centre 的报道，那里正在进行活动来计划一个菜园。
这个项目由中心主任 Jessica Plank 发起。
Plank 女士之前也因她在中心的贡献而受到认可。
就在上个月，她因对社区...服务做出的承诺，在 Town's Outstanding Citizens' Awards 颁奖典礼上获得了荣誉。
所有用于该项目的园艺工具都由 Endo Company 捐赠，该公司是该地区最大的景观公司之一。
